candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

stage1_output.decision_rationale: Title/abstract evidence indicates NLP usage to derive declarative process models from natural language descriptions, satisfying inclusion criteria for NLP-based process extraction/construction from text; The abstract explicitly mentions NLP techniques to identify roles, activities, and constraints and from text documents to generate declarative process models.

support_spans.quote: The Process Highlighter is a hybrid-modelling tool that facilitates the (manual) creation of Dynamic Response Condition (DCR) graphs directly from text documents, supporting non-technical users in the adoption of declarative process models.

stage2_output.decision_rationale: Stage 2 canonical criteria IC.1-IC.4 and EC.1-EC.4 are satisfied by Lopez et al. 2019: it is an English-language primary research article describing an NLP-enabled method to extract process components from natural-language text (Process Highlighter with NLP). The paper provides a concrete method (NLP-assisted marking of roles/activities/constraints) and references empirical evaluations of the tool, with statements about positive evaluations and exploratory results. The full text is available and the work demonstrates method description and empirical validation signals.
